title: Synthesis of unprotected thienyl sulfonamides and their activities against carbapenem-resistant Klebsiella pneumoniae, docking studies and ADMET analysis
content:
RSC Adv., 2025, 15,47700-47709
DOI: 10.1039/D5RA05409E, Paper

Muhammad Bilal, Mnaza Noreen, Muhammad Usman Qamar, Farhan Siddique, Nasir Rasool, Muhammad Imran
Substituted thiophene-based thienyl sulfonamides exhibit potent antibacterial activity against clinical CRKP isolates. Docking and ADMET studies identified compounds 3c, 3f, and 3g as promising lead candidates with favorable pharmacological profiles.
